What it is & how to play

Play as Tansy, an original egg-shaped gardener, through World 1’s four levels in order: Sunny Shelf, Stone Crossing, Islet Climb, and the Sulk Bulb. Move, jump, dive, and plant to tend each island. Pip the sprout follows and cheers when you clear a level. Choose Gentle, Breezy, or Bold before you start — they only change landing size and timing. Audience: casual players 13+. Progress stays on this device in localStorage.

Controls

Keyboard

Move: W A S D or arrows. Jump: 1 / numpad 1 (Space as backup once a level is running). Dive: Shift or C. Plant: E. Pause: Esc. Start: Enter.

Touch

Left stick to move; on-screen jump and dive buttons; drag the right side of the screen to look.

Tips

  • Clear levels in order — World 1 unlocks Sunny Shelf → Stone Crossing → Islet Climb → Sulk Bulb.
  • Try Gentle first if jumps feel tight; Breezy and Bold only change landing size and timing.
  • Plant with E when the prompt appears; Pip cheers when a level is cleared.
  • Mute and tier choices save locally — reopen the same browser to keep them.

FAQ

What is Pip's Bloom Isle?

A cozy 3D platformer-collector for casual players 13+. You play as Tansy tending four island levels while Pip the sprout follows and cheers.

How many levels are there?

World 1 ships four levels in order: Sunny Shelf, Stone Crossing, Islet Climb, and the Sulk Bulb.

What do Gentle, Breezy, and Bold change?

Only landing size and timing. They do not add or remove levels or story content.

Do I need an account or cookies?

No. Progress, chosen tier, mute, and seen hints stay in localStorage on this device only.

Does touch work?

Yes. Use the left stick, jump and dive buttons, and drag the right side to look.
